firstMessage:
`checkRefundLimit` now throws the new `InvalidRefundAmountError` for a zero or negative refund. Amounts above what is left on the charge still throw `RefundTooLargeError`. The suite passes: 37 tests, up from 36 because I split one test in two.

Changes:
- **`src/refunds.ts`**: added and exported `InvalidRefundAmountError`, modeled on the other error classes there. The `amount <= 0` check now runs first and throws it; the over-charge check follows and still throws `RefundTooLargeError`. I updated the doc comment to match.
- **`src/refunds.test.ts`**: the zero case moved out of the "rejects more than is left" test into a new test that covers zero and -1 with `InvalidRefundAmountError`.

REQUIREMENTS.md: R-REFUND-LIMIT still describes refunds as "must not exceed what is left of the original charge", and it doesn't mention the zero/negative case, so I left the requirements file alone. If you want that rule recorded there, it would need a new sentence in R-REFUND-LIMIT.

I did not commit anything.
finalMessage:
I took "go ahead" to mean the REQUIREMENTS.md update I offered last time. I added a sentence to R-REFUND-LIMIT: a refund must be more than zero, and a zero or negative refund is rejected with `InvalidRefundAmountError`. The suite still passes (37 of 37).

Nothing is committed. The three changed files are `REQUIREMENTS.md`, `src/refunds.ts` and `src/refunds.test.ts`. If you wanted a commit or a PR as well, tell me and I'll make it.
